scope: Eighteen frozen fixtures; accepted observations and explicit remaining qualification limits, not browser parity or overall product readiness.

method.text: Poppler pdftotext -raw; whitespace, layout hyphens and authored soft hyphens excluded from character multiset; generated note numbers and mathematical serialization punctuation explicitly accounted for. Unique numbered markers checked separately for count and order.
method.extractionLimit: Default Poppler layout extraction reorders some column markers; raw content order is preserved. This does not prove every reader or assistive technology order.
method.visual: All 25 PDF pages inspected through first-page and continuation sheets; current PNG and SVG bytes identical to the previously inspected math checkpoint. Scene/raster generation does not imply numerical visual parity.
method.images: pypdf image extraction against independently supplied RGBA fixtures
method.conformance: Separate exact-artifact policy probe recorded in static-html-pdf-conformance-20261003.json

finalVerification.localReview: Math-auto and conformance independently reviewed; final diagnostics-only change directly verified by focused and full tests, without a redundant full review.

remainingLimits: Standalone PDF/UA-1 with semantic MathML attachments remains rejected; combined PDF/A-3b/PDF/UA-1 is separately machine validated.
Manual accessibility and column-note assistive-technology order are unqualified.
The reference comparison run does not qualify separately requested reference-engine conformance policies.
Full MATH geometry, wider SVG/color profiles, additional language resources, native net472 execution, Windows/Linux budgets, and advertised AOT/trimming/WASM remain separate roadmap work.
